+	@YearID int = null,
+	@Semester int = null,
+	@ScienceID nvarchar(50) = null,
+	@SubjectGroupID nvarchar(50) = null,
+	@TeacherID nvarchar(50) = null,

+As
+Begin
+	Set Nocount On;
+	Select
+		SIM_Teacher.TeacherID
+	Into #tblTeacher
+	From SIM_Teacher

+	Where SIM_Teacher.TeacherID <> '0'
+		and (@ScienceID is null or SIM_SubjectGroup.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
+		and (@SubjectGroupID is null or SIM_Teacher.SubjectGroupID = @SubjectGroupID)
+		and (@TeacherID is null or SIM_Teacher.TeacherID = @TeacherID)
+	Select
+		SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID,
+		Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Total) as "TongGio_CongViec",
+		Sum(Case When SIM_TeacherWork.TeacherWorkGroupID <> 2 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Total Else 0 End) as "TongGio_CongViecChuyenMon",
+		Sum(Case When SIM_TeacherWork.TeacherWorkGroupID = 2 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Total Else 0 End) as "TongGio_CongViecKhac"
+	Into #tblTimeAdd
+	From SIM_TeachingTimeAdded
+		Inner Join SIM_TeacherWork on SIM_TeacherWork.TeacherWorkID = SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID
+	Where SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.YearID = @YearID
+		and SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Semester = @Semester
+	Group By SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID
+	Select
+		#tblTeacher.TeacherID,
+		SIM_TeachingPlan.StandardQuantity as "TongGio_Chuan",
+		SIM_TeachingPlan.RealStandardQuantity as "TongGio_Chuan_DaGiam",
+		SIM_TeachingPlan.StandardQuantity - SIM_TeachingPlan.RealStandardQuantity as "TongGio_ChucVu",
+		#tblTimeAdd.TongGio_CongViec,
+		#tblTimeAdd.TongGio_CongViecChuyenMon,
+		#tblTimeAdd.TongGio_CongViecKhac
+	Into #tblAddTime
+	From #tblTeacher
+		Left Join SIM_TeachingPlan on SIM_TeachingPlan.TeacherID = #tblTeacher.TeacherID
+			and SIM_TeachingPlan.YearID = @YearID
+			and SIM_TeachingPlan.Semester = @Semester
+		Left Join #tblTimeAdd on #tblTimeAdd.TeacherID = #tblTeacher.TeacherID
+	Select
+		SIM_Student.ClassID,
+		Count(*) as StudentCount
+	Into #tblClassSize
+	From SIM_Student
+	Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
+		and SIM_Student.Status = 1
+	Group By SIM_Student.ClassID
+	Union
+	Select
+		SIM_RegisterLogicClass.ClassID,
+		Count(*) as StudentCount
+	From SIM_RegisterLogicClass
+	Where SIM_RegisterLogicClass.YearID = @YearID
+		and SIM_RegisterLogicClass.Semester = @Semester
+	Group By SIM_RegisterLogicClass.ClassID
+	Union
+	Select
+		SIM_Class.ClassID,
+		SIM_Class.ClassSize
+	From SIM_Class
+	Where SIM_Class.ClassType <> 0
+	Insert Into #tblClassSize
+	(
+		ClassID,
+		StudentCount
+	)
+	Select
+		SIM_Class.ClassID,
+		SIM_Class.ClassSize
+	From SIM_Class
+	Where SIM_Class.ClassType = 0
+		and SIM_Class.ClassID Not In
+		(
+			Select
+				#tblClassSize.ClassID
+			From #tblClassSize
+		)
+	Select
+		#tblClassSize.ClassID,
+		#tblClassSize.StudentCount,
+		Case
+			When #tblClassSize.StudentCount < 36 Then 1
+			When #tblClassSize.StudentCount > 50 Then 1.3
+			Else 1.2
+		End as TheoryRatio,
+		Case
+			When #tblClassSize.StudentCount < 26 Then 1
+			When #tblClassSize.StudentCount > 30 Then 1.3
+			Else 1.2
+		End as PracticeRatio
+	Into #tblStudentCount
+	From #tblClassSize
+	Drop Table #tblClassSize
+	Select
+		SIM_Teacher.TeacherID,
+		SIM_Teacher.SubjectGroupID,
+		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName as "TeacherName",
+		SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID,
+		SIM_Subject.SubjectName,
+		Case When SIM_Class.ClassType = 2 Then tblClassSubject2.ClassID Else SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID End as ClassID,
+		Case When SIM_Class.ClassType = 1 Then '*' When SIM_Class.GroupSmallClass = 0 Then '' Else Ltrim(Str(SIM_Class.GroupSmallClass)) End as GroupSmallClass,
+		SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID,
+		SIM_Class_Subject.YearID,
+		SIM_Class_Subject.Semester,
+		SIM_Class.ClassSize as "DoMarkExamCount",
+		SIM_MethodTest.DoMarkExamRatio,
+		Round(SIM_Class.ClassSize * SIM_MethodTest.DoMarkExamRatio, 1) as "DoMarkExamQuantity",
+		SIM_MethodTest.RequestExamCount,
+		SIM_MethodTest.CreateExamRatio,
+		Round(SIM_MethodTest.RequestExamCount * SIM_MethodTest.CreateExamRatio, 1) as "CreateExamQuantity",
+		tblReplaceTeacher.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + tblReplaceTeacher.TeacherLastName as "ReplaceTeacherName"
+	Into #tblTeachingPlan
+	From #tblTeacher
+		Inner Join SIM_Class_Subject on SIM_Class_Subject.TeachingBy = #tblTeacher.TeacherID
+			and SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectStatus Not In (1, 2)
+		Inner Join SIM_MethodTest on SIM_MethodTest.MethodTestID = SIM_Class_Subject.MethodTestID
+		Inner Join SIM_Subject on SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
+		Inner Join SIM_Class on SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID
+		Inner Join SIM_Teacher on SIM_Teacher.TeacherID = SIM_Class_Subject.TeachingBy
+		Inner Join SIM_SubjectGroup on SIM_SubjectGroup.SubjectGroupID = SIM_Teacher.SubjectGroupID
+		Left Join SIM_Class_Subject tblClassSubject2 on tblClassSubject2.ClassSubjectID = SIM_Class.ClassSubjectID
+		Left Join SIM_Teacher tblReplaceTeacher on tblReplaceTeacher.TeacherID = SIM_Class_Subject.ReplaceTeacherID
+	Where SIM_Class_Subject.YearID = @YearID
+		and SIM_Class_Subject.Semester = @Semester
+		and SIM_Class.IsActived = 1
+		and (@ScienceID is null or SIM_SubjectGroup.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
+		and (@SubjectGroupID is null or SIM_Teacher.SubjectGroupID = @SubjectGroupID)
+		and (@TeacherID is null or SIM_Teacher.TeacherID = @TeacherID)
+	Select
+		#tblTeachingPlan.TeacherID,
+		Round(Sum(#tblTeachingPlan.DoMarkExamCount), 0) as DoMarkExamCount,
+		Round(Sum(#tblTeachingPlan.DoMarkExamQuantity), 1) as "DoMarkExamQuantity",
+		Sum(#tblTeachingPlan.RequestExamCount) as RequestExamCount,
+		Round(Sum(#tblTeachingPlan.CreateExamQuantity), 1) as CreateExamQuantity
+	Into #tblTeachingPlanSummary
+	From #tblTeachingPlan
+	Group By #tblTeachingPlan.TeacherID
+	Select

+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 6 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_6,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 7 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_7,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 8 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_8,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 9 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_9,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 10 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_10,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 11 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_11,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 12 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_12,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 13 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_13,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 14 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_14,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 15 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_15,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 16 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_16,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 17 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_17,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 18 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_18,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 19 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_19,
+		Sum(Case When SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Week = 20 Then SIM_WeekDetailPlan.Quantity Else 0 End) as Week_20,
